question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.

guide_solution: (a) Morning walk which is not only pleasant but also beneficial to health is a very good habit. (b) One should walk in the morning when nature appears at her best and everything remains quiet and seems impressive. (c) The people who go out for a walk in the morning cannot but be impressed by the quietness of nature. (d) Morning walk not only helps to keep our mind jolly and jovial but also sets our temper for the rest of the day. (e) Thus the man who goes out for a walk in the morning inhales fresh and pure air and feels its invigorating effect.
